messages:
harry: FYI saw another tenant billing blip this morning. digging in, looks like retries + cross-region requeueing created duplicate token charges. want to propose an observability + schema approach to prevent this showing up in invoices.

jess: propose summary?

harry: short: (1) carry a stable request fingerprint through the entire ingress->batch->runtime pipeline as a trace attribute (request.fingerprint), (2) surface that fingerprint in telemetry (traces/logs/metrics), (3) use it for post-fact dedupe in billing aggregation and for realtime batcher dedupe heuristics.

maya: how do we generate fingerprint? hash(body + canonicalized headers + content-type) ? worries about cardinality if we attach to metrics.

harry: good point. two-part plan: generate a 64-bit fingerprint (non-cryptographic, e.g., xxhash64) at the edge. keep fingerprint present in trace/span root and as an optional label on usage counters only during dedupe windows. do NOT attach fingerprint to long-retention cardinality metrics.

zoe: canonicalization rules matter. for JSON bodies we should stable-serialize (sorted keys) before hashing; for form-encoded use normalized ordering; for binary just raw hash. we need a library in go/python that matches edge and runtime.

jess: tradeoffs: smaller fingerprint reduces storage but increases collision chance -> wrong dedupe. also adding an attribute to spans increases trace size. how do we measure collision risk?

harry: we can simulate collision rate with tenant payload samples. xxhash64 collision probability at our scale (10B reqs/year) is negligible (~1e-7). we still keep fallback: billing pipeline will only dedupe when token counts and other fields (model, prompt-length, tenant-id) also match within a tolerance. so fingerprint is necessary but not sole signal.

maya: another concern: instrumentation drift. if edge canonicalizer differs from runtime canonicalizer we'll miss matches. we should publish a single canonicalization spec + shared lib and embed version (request.fingerprint.v) into spans so pipeline knows which scheme produced it.

zoe: implementation steps I'd take: 1) RFC for "request fingerprint" spec + library (v1: JSON stable serialize, form normalize, raw binary); 2) edge: compute fingerprint and attach as root trace attribute + X-Req-Fp header; 3) batcher: prefer X-Req-Fp for dedupe; 4) billing ingest: add fingerprint-aware dedupe stage with conservative matching rules and telemetry.`

jess: how about observability impacts? dashboards, SLI, cost attribution?

harry: add metrics: dedupe_candidates_total, deduped_token_estimate, fingerprint_scheme_version as a tag on traces. Keep per-tenant dedupe estimates but roll up fingerprints only in ephemeral stores (24h) to avoid long-term cardinality.

maya: would this help tracing continuity across cross-region retries? yes. also useful for debugging which proxy produced the accepted request if we include proxy-id in the fingerprint provenance.

zoe: infra-bot: create ticket?

infra-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-1342 "request-fingerprint RFC + billing dedupe pipeline". Canary repo created.

jess: action items: harry write RFC draft with canonicalization spec + sample code; maya run collision sims on sample corpus; zoe prototype edge header and short-lived dedupe cache; i'll add dashboard rows for dedupe_* metrics. reconvene Thurs 9am PT. :thumbsup:
